experiment.policy: One fresh start per case, no replacements. Stop launching on source change, credential failure or no successful final model calls in a finished case.

limitations: One attempt per case; no replacement sessions and no matched control batch.
Historical best scores are selected best-of-many outcomes, not controls.
The optional trade menu was enabled for every case; this batch cannot isolate its causal effect.
Each case started with an identical memory snapshot, then learned only within its own copy.
A successful model response or a completed process is not proof of a good deal.
Reported tokens omit any usage not returned for failed requests; no billing cost is inferred.
